description: This file defines the I18NLanguageModel class which implements the Normalizable interface. It is used to create a model representation of the I18NLanguage entity, specifying which attributes and filters are available for serialization and normalization in API responses within the context of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: I18NLanguageModel
classes.description: A model class that wraps around the I18NLanguage entity to provide serialization support for API responses, defining which properties are exposed and how they are filtered.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the I18NLanguageModel with an I18NLanguage entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
